newsitem.title: USA: Environmental Tech says CEO suspended.
newsitem.headline: Environmental Tech says CEO suspended.

text.p: Environmental Technologies Corp Wednesday said Brin McCagg has been suspended as chief executive officer while the company reviews certain potential irregularities concerning its FulCircle Recyclers Inc unit.
McCagg was not available for comment.
The company expects to complete its review within one month and its board will then take whatever actions it considers appropriate.

During this suspension, George Cannan, the company's chairman, as well as its CEO prior to retaining McCagg in January 1996, has assumed the duties of CEO. The company does not anticipate that the suspension will impact its business or day-to-day operations.
McCagg has resigned as a member of the board, the company said. A company declined to elaborate, saying the matter was still being investigated.
Later the attorney, David J. Duquette Jr, released the following statement.
"McCagg categorically denies any wrong doing on his part. He will pursue whatever measures are necessary to see that there is not even an implication that he committed any wrongdoing."
